name: California Raptor Center volunteer program
reason: All volunteers must be 18 or older. Fall 2026 shifts are full.

name: Sutter Davis Hospital Auxiliary volunteers
reason: The page says it does not accept student volunteers, including high school students.

name: Sacramento Zoo Animal Care Volunteers
reason: Ages 18 and up. Teens should use Zoo Teens or Summer Camp Counselor instead.

name: Yolo County College Intern Program
reason: Priority is college students. The older Yolo County High School Summer Intern Program (ages 15 to 19) appears only in 2009 to 2013 documents and is not listed on the current HR site.

name: Thousand Strong (City of Sacramento paid internships)
reason: Not listed on the current City Youth Workforce Development page. Last news found was the 2024-25 cohort, and the only application form seen was for 2018-2019. Unconfirmed for 2026-27.

name: Semester @ City Hall (City of Sacramento)
reason: Listed in the site menu but the page returned not found. Details could not be confirmed.

name: Explorit Science Center volunteers (Davis)
reason: Page lists volunteers 14 and up, but its next training date is a stale September 29 and a search result said Explorit is pausing operations. Unconfirmed.

name: UC Davis Arboretum Learning by Leading internships
reason: Search results describe it as quarter-based internships for UC Davis undergraduates, not high school students.

name: Mondavi Center volunteer ushers
reason: The page lists no age rule and asks for community volunteers who stand for long periods. Ask the Mondavi Center about teen ushering before listing.

name: Cal Expo and State Fair seasonal jobs
reason: The careers page gives no minimum age and points to state civil service postings. Teen eligibility not confirmed.

name: SacRT youth internships
reason: No high school internship found. SacRT has a Scout patch program and RydeFreeRT for youth fares, which are not jobs.

name: Sacramento Kings internships
reason: Search results describe college-level internships and Kings University. No high school program confirmed.

name: City of West Sacramento Summer STEPS Internship
reason: Search snippet describes a paid internship for students bridging academic study and work. Could not confirm it accepts high schoolers.

name: Crocker Art Museum Teen Art Labs
reason: Paid art classes for ages 13 to 17 ($35 to $80), not work experience. Left out of the main list.

name: City of Davis seasonal recreation jobs
reason: Jobs are posted only when open, with age rules in each posting. A 2009 Aggie article said a recreation job fair is held, but no current minimum age was confirmed.

name: Folsom Teen Council and Woodland Youth Council
reason: Seen only in search snippets. Not read on official pages.

name: Intel Folsom, Sacramento Metro Chamber, local Rotary and Kiwanis youth internships
reason: Searched but no official high school internship program found in the time available.
